observation.command:
echo "=== deegree remote-OWS self refs (mapserver.xml) ==="; grep -rn "localhost:8080" /opt/deegree/*/datasources/remoteows/*.xml 2>/dev/null
echo "=== any other localhost:8080 refs in workspaces ==="; grep -rln "localhost:8080" /opt/deegree 2>/dev/null | grep -v remoteows | head
echo "=== webapps.properties in each war (context->workspace) ==="; for w in xplan-services-wms xplan-services-wfs xplan-services-wfs-syn xplan-webservices-validator-wms xplan-webservices-inspireplu; do echo "-- $w:"; python3 -c "import zipfile,sys; d=zipfile.ZipFile('/tmp/dist/web/$w.war'); n=[x for x in d.namelist() if 'webapps.properties' in x or 'webapp.properties' in x]; print(n)"; done
